{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Ken'karro''''' was the form of government used by the [[Kriek]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Each individual ''ken'karro'' had both a [[Gender/Legends|male]] and female representative and was led by a ''[[k'lar]]''.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|208|''ken'karro''}}</ref>
